matrix_name.name: poly(vinylidene fluoride)
matrix_name.description: PVDF matrix in a homogeneous blend composite containing graphene nanoplatelets, nickel, and carbon nanotubes; no layer separation.

fillers.name: graphene nanoplatelets
fillers.description: Conductive filler blended throughout the PVDF matrix.

fillers.name: nickel
fillers.description: Magnetic nickel powder blended throughout the PVDF matrix.

fillers.name: carbon nanotubes
fillers.description: NC7000 multiwalled carbon nanotubes blended throughout the PVDF matrix.

matrix_name.name: poly(vinylidene fluoride)
matrix_name.description: PVDF matrix in a three-layer sandwich composite with layer order graphene nanoplatelets/nickel/carbon nanotubes; total thickness 0.3 mm, corresponding to approximately 0.1 mm per layer.

fillers.name: graphene nanoplatelets
fillers.description: Conductive filler in the first outer layer of the three-layer sandwich.

fillers.name: nickel
fillers.description: Magnetic filler in the middle layer of the three-layer sandwich.

fillers.name: carbon nanotubes
fillers.description: NC7000 multiwalled carbon nanotubes in the second outer layer of the three-layer sandwich.

matrix_name.description: PVDF matrix in a six-layer sandwich composite with repeating layer order graphene nanoplatelets/nickel/carbon nanotubes/graphene nanoplatelets/nickel/carbon nanotubes; total thickness 0.6 mm.
